mainText: Hello, Verona! At 3 PM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 77 degrees and clear near the Verona Public Library, though we do have an elevated air quality reading of 53.

In city news, the Public Works department reminds residents to inspect mailboxes for winter durability and to follow official damage claim procedures if hit by city equipment. Additionally, the City Clerk is accepting student designs for a local I Voted sticker contest through July 22nd.

Today features Yoga at Insight Wellness, live music at the Concerts in the Park series, and trivia at Hop Haus Brewing Company. Tomorrow, you can catch live music at Bailey's Run Vineyard and the Wisconsin Brewing Company.
In a report from July 13th, the Verona Police Department responded to a call where a driver was arrested for an O-W-I after their vehicle became trapped on a large rock.
Treat yourself to the Really Reese's flavor of the day at our local Culver's, which remains open until 10 PM tonight.
